annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.summary_en: 1995 European Commission proposal for a Directive setting emission limits and type-approval procedures for diesel engines in non-road mobile machinery (excavators, forklifts), in two stages (1997–2003). It has no AI or robotics content; it concerns air pollution, harmonised type-approval and conformity of production.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type-approval of compression-ignition engines for non-road mobile machinery, with engine-family concept
Two-stage emission limits: Stage I 1997–1998, Stage II 2001–2003
Manufacturer marking, declarations and conformity-of-production checks
Mutual recognition of equivalent approvals (Directive 88/77/EEC, UN/ECE R49)
Optional tax incentives and exemptions for end-of-series and military engines
